name: Neural Radiosity
definition: An algorithm to find a solution of the rendering equation using a single neural network. The radiance function L(x, ωo) is represented by a neural network with parameters φ, denoted Lφ(x, ωo). The parameters are optimized by minimizing the norm of the residual of the rendering equation.
summary: Neural Radiosity is an inverse rendering method that optimizes a neural network to minimize the rendering equation's residual, avoiding the memory overhead of storing full computation graphs.
